subject: Outstanding invoice cadence + EU tax evidence needed
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@cedarcare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Outstanding invoice cadence + EU tax evidence needed

Hi Miguel —

Following up on invoice INV-2026-09-87 (USD 112,450) which fell due 09/15. Our AR records show it’s still outstanding. Can you confirm receipt and the expected payment date?

A couple of important notes for reconciliation:
- CedarCare’s billing was routed to the US entity in July but you’ve indicated some EU entity mapping in your portal — we need a written tax certificate from the EU entity to support VAT-free treatment on our side.
- If you can’t provide the certificate by EOD Friday (10/02), we’ll need to move the account into the standard dunning cadence (email reminders + 7-day notice), which may involve our collections partner.

Attaching the invoice and our proposed dunning cadence (DunningSequence-v2.xlsx) to make the next steps explicit.

If cash timing is tight, we can discuss a short two-part payment plan, but I need an indication today so we can pause escalation.

Thanks —

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: INV-2026-09-87.pdf (invoice, 1 page), DunningSequence-v2.xlsx (proposed cadence)
From: Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@cedarcare.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice cadence + EU tax evidence needed

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the reminder and sorry for the delay. We received the invoice and it’s approved in our system, but the payment team is waiting on a certificate from our EU legal team to confirm entity routing (there was an internal ERP change last month). I’ve escalated internally and expect to have the EU tax cert by Friday 10/02 COB.

If it helps, I can send a screenshot of the payment approval in our AP workflow this afternoon — won’t be final payment but shows it’s queued.

Regards,
Miguel
Miguel Alvarez
Director, Finance Operations
CedarCare Health Systems
miguel.alvarez@cedarcare.com

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Outstanding invoice cadence + EU tax evidence needed

Markus / Monica —

Looping you in. Miguel says payment is approved and they expect the EU tax certificate by COB today. If we do not receive the certificate or a firm payment date by EOD, I plan to:
1) Move CedarCare into our Stage 2 dunning cadence tomorrow (automated reminder + collections notice).
2) Engage LedgerBridge for outreach if Stage 2 fails to elicit payment within 7 days.
3) Pause any near-term account credits or SOW work until cleared.

Monica — would like your input on running the collections vendor (we’ve used LedgerBridge once before and they charged a flat fee + success contingency).

Thanks,
—Lauren

> Miguel Alvarez wrote:
> > Thanks for the reminder and sorry for the delay. We received the invoice and it’s approved in our system, but the payment team is waiting on a certificate from our EU legal team to confirm entity routing...

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Outstanding invoice cadence + EU tax evidence needed

Thanks for the context, Lauren. Two quick asks from leadership:

1) If Miguel delivers the EU tax certificate by COB today, we accept it as sufficient and will keep the account in good standing — no collections. Please confirm receipt and forward the PDF immediately.
2) If we don’t receive evidence, proceed with Stage 2 dunning tomorrow but do not initiate LedgerBridge until we have exhausted internal outreach (2 phone attempts + 1 exec email). Escalation to collections requires my sign-off.

Monica — coordinate with Legal to confirm the checklist we require on the tax certificate (entity name match, registration number, effective date). I’m copying Finance to make them aware we may need a short hold on service credits tied to this account.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@cedarcare.com>, CedarCare Finance <finance@cedarcare.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, LedgerBridge Collections <collections@ledgerbridge.io>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Outstanding invoice cadence + EU tax evidence needed

Miguel —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We received the CedarCare-EU-tax-cert.pdf at 14:07 your time and Legal has confirmed it matches the entity name on our contract (CedarCare EU Holdings). That satisfies our VAT evidence requirement so we will NOT move to Stage 2 dunning at this time.

Next steps agreed:
- CedarCare to remit full payment by 10/09. Please confirm if your AP needs a wire vs ACH and the remittance details.
- If payment misses 10/09, we will escalate per the DunningSequence-v2.xlsx (7-day formal notice, then collections outreach).
- No LedgerBridge activation unless we fail to secure payment after our internal outreach.

Can you confirm payment method and whether a remittance advice will be provided? If a partial payment is necessary, let us know now so we can update the account schedule.

Thanks —
Lauren
—Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
